postal_system.assignment_rule: Azərpoçt postcode, branch, and locality evidence establishes postal assignment. The UPU AZNNNN convention and four-digit syntax do not establish a current allocation.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: No nationwide official postcode-polygon source is assumed. A surface is derived only from rights-cleared, versioned official address membership and compatible boundary evidence, and remains explicitly derived.
postal_system.address_rule: The official Ünvan Reyestri İnformasiya Sistemi supplies settlement, postcode, transport-infrastructure, and immovable-property address context. Portal visibility is not treated as a bulk redistribution license.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires the same official address or cadastral object identifier, or a reviewed explicit crosswalk. Address points, parcels, containment, and proximity remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Government administrative and cadastral geometry supplies jurisdiction and clipping context but never creates postal membership.
postal_system.territory_rule: Postal assignment never determines sovereignty or a disputed administrative boundary. Preserve source jurisdiction and validity, keep multipart components separate, and never bridge the Nakhchivan exclave or cross-border gaps.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal, address, cadastral, and boundary validity when supplied by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Source publication, capture, ingest, correction, and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: Later postal or registry evidence appends a versioned assertion and never silently rewrites an earlier release.

quality_gates.pass: Each postcode assignment references a pinned Azərpoçt receipt or permitted release and retains record class, locality, capture time, rights, and digest.
Every derived surface retains member addresses, derivation method, parameters, boundary clips, validation metrics, source releases, rights, and digest; it is never labelled official.
Each address assertion retains its official object identifier, hierarchy, status, coordinates when published, source release, and permitted public fields.
An exact building has the same official address/cadastral object identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk; spatial proximity is candidate-only.
Components remain source-backed and unbridged; postcode evidence does not infer sovereignty, disputed boundaries, or cross-border membership.
No recipient, resident, owner, tenant, occupant, phone, credential, title, or protected registry field is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
